lead.purpose: Paragraph beside or under a display heading, 36 to 46ch.

body.purpose: All running text; legal prose at 1.75 line height and 68ch.

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.875rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.875rem 1.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -1px -40%; z-index: -1; background: var(--ds-fill); transform: translateX(-102%) skewX(30.964deg); transition: transform 620ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover::before, .ds-btn:focus-visible::before { transform: translateX(0) skewX(30.964deg); } .ds-arrow { width: 1.25rem; transition: translate 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-arrow, .ds-btn:focus-visible .ds-arrow { translate: 0.3rem 0; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-700, #034cbe); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--color-paper-50, #fdfaf6); } .ds-btn-solid { background: var(--color-brand-600, #0065ea); color: var(--color-paper-50, #fdfaf6); --ds-fill: var(--color-brand-700, #034cbe); }

components.css: .ds-paper { background: var(--color-paper-100, #f9f5ef); padding: 2rem; } .ds-gbtn { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.875rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.875rem 1.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-brand-900, #082358); border-radius: 0; color: var(--color-brand-900, #082358); font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-gbtn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -1px -40%; z-index: -1; background: var(--color-brand-900, #082358); transform: translateX(-102%) skewX(30.964deg); transition: transform 620ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-gbtn:hover, .ds-gbtn:focus-visible { color: var(--color-paper-50, #fdfaf6); } .ds-gbtn:hover::before, .ds-gbtn:focus-visible::before { transform: translateX(0) skewX(30.964deg); } .ds-garrow { width: 1.25rem; transition: translate 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-gbtn:hover .ds-garrow { translate: 0.3rem 0; } .ds-gbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-700, #034cbe); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--color-paper-50, #fdfaf6); }

components.css: .ds-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 2rem; background: var(--color-paper-100, #f9f5ef); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-brand-900, #082358); } .ds-rows li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-brand-900, #082358); } .ds-row { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5fr 5fr 2fr; gap: 2rem; align-items: center; padding: 3.5rem 0; text-decoration: none; --t-strong: var(--color-ink-900, #0a1932); --t-body: var(--color-ink-700, #324058); --t-accent: var(--color-brand-700, #034cbe); } .ds-row::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 -40%; z-index: -1; background: var(--color-brand-900, #082358); transform: translateX(-101%) skewX(30.964deg); transition: transform 760ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row:hover, .ds-row:focus-visible { --t-strong: var(--color-paper-50, #fdfaf6); --t-body: var(--color-mist-100, #e6e9f0); --t-accent: var(--color-brand-300, #99bfff); } .ds-row:hover::before, .ds-row:focus-visible::before { transform: translateX(0) skewX(30.964deg); } .ds-row > * { transition: color 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), translate 760ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row:hover > * { translate: 1.25rem 0; } .ds-row:hover > :last-child { translate: -1.5rem 0; } .ds-row-name { font-family: 'Noto Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 300; font-size: 4rem; line-height: 1.03; color: var(--t-strong); } .ds-row-tag { display: block; font-family: 'Noto Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 1.625rem; color: var(--t-accent); } .ds-row-intro { display: block; margin-top: 0.75rem; font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--t-body); } .ds-row-more { justify-self: end; font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; color: var(--t-accent); } .ds-row, .ds-row * { transition-property: color, translate; }

components.css: .ds-nav { background: var(--color-void, #050f28); height: 4.5rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 0 2rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(174 187 212 / 0.14); } .ds-nav ul { display: flex; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav li { padding: 0 1.5rem; } .ds-nav li + li { border-left: 1px solid rgb(174 187 212 / 0.28); } .ds-nav a { font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-paper-50, #fdfaf6); text-decoration: none; background-image: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor); background-position: 0 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 0 1px; padding: 0.25rem 0; transition: background-size 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { background-size: 100% 1px; } .ds-nav a.ds-nav-lang { color: var(--color-brand-300, #99bfff); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-300, #99bfff); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--color-void, #050f28); }

narrative.overview:
The site stands as a building facade drawn in hairlines. Deep navy bands carry an inline SVG curtain wall of mullions, floor lines and glass panes, all running at the one angle the company owns: the knockout seam of its logo, measured at 3:5, or 59.036 degrees from horizontal. Warm paper bands carry the reading. The two alternate down every page the way glass alternates with slab, and the footer closes on the deepest void ground.

Density is low and deliberate. Headlines are set large in a serif, in one colour, columns are split by vertical hairline rules rather than boxed, and the registered identity of the company is laid out as a ruled register, the way it reads on the company's own documents. Nothing is photographed; the building is computed at build time from the mark's geometry, so the imagery belongs to Veltrex rather than to a stock library. Every corner is square because the mark is all straight edges and one hard fold.

Motion is the building's own material moving. Above the fold the hero assembles in pure CSS; below the fold nothing fades and nothing starts hidden, only rules and facades draw. Reduced motion, print and no script all render the page complete.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating navy facade bands and warm paper reading bands, void footer.
One angle everywhere: mullions, button sweeps, runner lanes, menu ruling and tower motion run along the 59.036 degree seam.
Serif display in one colour per headline over a quiet humanist sans.
Hairline rules instead of containers; square corners; flat surfaces.
Brand blue is scarce: the mark, one solid action per view, live accents.
Registered identity rendered as a ruled register, with unknown identifiers structurally absent.

rules.name: The Scarce Blue Rule
rules.body: Brand blue appears only in the mark, the one solid primary action per view and live accents. Links on paper are brand-700; links on navy are brand-300. Ramp 400 is the lowest step ever allowed as text on navy.

rules.name: The One World Rule
rules.body: There is no dark theme. Under a dark colour scheme paper bands stay paper, because the alternation is the design; the navy bands already give dark scheme visitors their dark ground. Navy and void grounds re-point every text, rule, ghost and focus role through the ground attribute, so a component never needs to know which band it sits in, and colour scheme is declared per ground.

rules.name: The Tinted Extremes Rule
rules.body: No pure black and no pure white as a design value, including shadows, borders, overlays, scrims and gradient stops. The extremes are void and paper-50; translucent overlays are built from void, mist or brand-100 channels.

rules.name: The Ground Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every text pairing and focus ring is computed against the ground it sits on before it ships. The focus ring is brand-700 with a paper-50 halo on paper, and brand-300 with a navy or void halo on dark grounds.

rules.name: The One Colour Headline Rule
rules.body: A headline is one colour. Never set one phrase in the text colour and the next in an accent colour. Emphasis in display type, where there is any, is italic, never bold.

rules.name: The Locale Case Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is applied to strings at render time with the locale aware helper built on toLocaleUpperCase. Never CSS text transform on Turkish text, and never an all caps value in a message catalogue.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Phone numbers and registry identifiers use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Anchored Seam Rule
rules.body: On the home hero the facade is sized by height and slid sideways so the near tower's lit edge passes exactly through the fold of the header logo at every viewport width. The drawing is 3600 units wide with 800 units to the left of that edge, and the stylesheet offset reads the same logo height, header height and gutter. Change any of them together.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Box Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px rules: vertical rules between columns, horizontal rules between rows, a strong top rule over lists. No cards, no panels, no drop shadows.

dos: Do alternate navy facade bands with paper reading bands, and close every page on the void footer.
Do run every angled device at the seam (59.036 degrees, skew 30.964 degrees).
Do set the ground attribute on every navy or void band so text, rule, ghost and focus roles re-point.
Do keep brand blue to the mark, one solid primary action per view and live accents; use brand-700 for links on paper and brand-300 on navy.
Do divide content with 1px vertical and horizontal rules and keep every corner square.
Do uppercase with the locale aware helper, and keep catalogue strings in natural case.
Do let reduced motion, print and no script show everything complete.
Do render unknown registry identifiers as structurally absent.
donts: Don't use pure black or pure white anywhere, including scrims, rules, shadows and gradient stops.
Don't approximate the brand navy or brand blue, and don't set brand blue as text on a navy or void ground.
Don't give paper bands a dark variant under a dark colour scheme.
Don't fade or hide content below the fold; only rules and facades draw, one device per band.
Don't use cards, rounded corners, drop shadows, section numbers or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use photography or stock architecture; the facade is drawn from the mark.
Don't use CSS text transform on Turkish text.
Don't use the brand grey for anything but the logo tagline.
